dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail Message Board
dialogues.text: If you have anything to share, be it brooding or joyous, distressing or hilarious, write them down on our Message Board! Cat's Tail is all cat ears!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Surely I'm not the only one? Dealing with the Fatui is such a chore. The Acting Grand Master must be exhausted."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Coming to Mondstadt with their big heads of theirs... Even telling us to accept their rule... Shameless scum. They wouldn't dare try this kind of thing with Boreas..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "For the freedom of Mondstadt, I shall do my best. Though I am just a guard, I still have my pride as a child of Mondstadt!"

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: For Mondstadt's freedom, for Mondstadt's freedom! It's the cause we strive for! Cheers!
